text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I killed this break! I redid my nails and went shopping and stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahh, it was the best break ever! Hey, what if we took today off too?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: …I know, I know. We have to train. Fiiine, you don't need to tell me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Tosen Jordan has recharged her batteries after a fulfilling break!
